display.purpose: Page titles in the page head; smaller clamp in the Home hero.

headline.purpose: Section titles, closing-band calls, year labels, package names.

title.purpose: Row and tile titles, checkpoint labels, flagship and role names.

lead.purpose: The paragraph under a display or headline, muted ink, max 58ch.

label.purpose: Buttons, form labels, nav tiles, dates and counts; sentence case.

shadows.name: checkpoint-bevel
shadows.purpose: Relief of a reflective checkpoint tile; checkpoints only.

shadows.name: sheet-lift
shadows.purpose: Modal sheets over a rgba(0,0,0,0.72) scrim; sheets only.

shadows.name: focus-halo
shadows.purpose: Focused inputs and the member search, with a royal-blue border.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Press feedback, sheet entry, image zoom, checkpoint glint.

motion.name: ease-move
motion.purpose: Robot marker travel between nav tiles (460ms) and down the year rail (420ms).

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Active state of checkpoints, buttons and map tiles (icon buttons 0.94).

motion.name: state-change
motion.purpose: Hover/selected color and background changes; hover only on fine pointers.

motion.name: sheet-in
motion.value: fade 200ms ease-out; panel 260ms ease-out from translateY(12px) scale(0.98); bottom sheets slide up on small screens

motion.name: sponsor-run
motion.purpose: User-pinned sponsor marquee; paused on hover/focus, static under reduced motion.

components.name: Checkpoint Tile
components.description: The only primary-action frame: Apply to Candidates, Become a sponsor, and form submits.
components.html: Apply to Candidates
components.css: .ds-checkpoint { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; min-width: 240px; min-height: 64px; padding: 14px 18px 16px; background: #b9bdc3; color: #000; font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-stretch: 112%; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.05rem; line-height: 1.15; text-decoration: none; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 #d6d9dd, inset 0 -2px 0 #9599a0; overflow: hidden; transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-checkpoint::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(105deg, transparent 35%, rgba(255,255,255,0.55) 50%, transparent 65%); transform: translateX(-100%); pointer-events: none; } .ds-checkpoint:hover::after { transform: translateX(100%); transition: transform 700ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-checkpoint:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-checkpoint:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #8aa6f5; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Wall Button
components.description: Secondary action: a light-ink wall outline that inverts on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-wall { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 48px; padding: 11px 18px; border: 2px solid #ecedea; background: #111214; color: #ecedea; font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 650; font-size: 0.95rem; line-height: 1.2; text-decoration: none; transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), background-color 160ms ease, color 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-wall:hover { background: #ecedea; color: #111214; } .ds-btn-wall:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-wall:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #8aa6f5; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Segmented Switch
components.description: Flush segmented control for status filter and ES/EN toggle; the pressed option inverts.
components.css: .ds-switch { display: inline-flex; border: 2px solid #ecedea; background: #111214; } .ds-switch button { height: 38px; padding: 0 14px; border: 0; background: none; color: #ecedea; font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms ease, color 160ms ease; } .ds-switch button + button { border-left: 2px solid #ecedea; } .ds-switch button[aria-pressed='true'] { background: #ecedea; color: #111214; } .ds-switch button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #8aa6f5; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Area filter on the roster; pressed fills royal blue, unmatched entries dim instead of hiding.
components.css: .ds-chips { display: flex; gap: 6px; background: #111214; padding: 8px; } .ds-chip { height: 34px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1.5px solid #2a2d31; background: none; color: #b8bcc1; font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 550; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 160ms ease, background-color 160ms ease, color 160ms ease; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: #ecedea; color: #ecedea; } .ds-chip[aria-pressed='true'] { background: #1f4fd1; border-color: #1f4fd1; color: #fff; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #8aa6f5; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Form field with label above; blue border and halo on focus, red on error.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; padding: 12px; background: #111214; color: #ecedea; font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field span { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 650; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; padding: 12px 14px; border: 2px solid #ecedea; border-radius: 0; background: #1a1c1f; color: #ecedea; font: inherit; font-size: 17px; transition: box-shadow 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: #8c9198; } .ds-field input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #1f4fd1; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(31,79,209,0.25); }

components.name: Nav Tile Strip
components.description: Six seam-divided nav tiles under a 4px wall; current tile raised, visited tiles mapped, robot marker on the current tile.
components.html: HomeAboutProjectsMembers
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; height: 76px; background: #111214; border-bottom: 4px solid #ecedea; border-left: 1px solid #2a2d31; font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-tile { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-width: 104px; padding: 0 16px 10px; border-right: 1px solid #2a2d31; color: #b8bcc1; font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 160ms ease, color 160ms ease; } .ds-nav-tile:hover, .ds-nav-tile.is-here { background: #1a1c1f; color: #ecedea; } .ds-nav-tile:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #8aa6f5; outline-offset: -3px; } .ds-mapped { position: absolute; top: 10px; right: 10px; width: 6px; height: 6px; background: #9599a0; } .ds-robot { position: absolute; left: 50%; bottom: 2px; width: 14px; height: 20px; margin-left: -7px; background: #1a1c1f; border: 1.5px solid #ecedea; box-shadow: inset 0 3px 0 #1f4fd1; }

components.name: Threshold
components.description: Section divider: a full-width wall with one doorway gap in its second tile.
components.css: .ds-threshold-wrap { padding: 32px 16px; background: #111214; } .ds-threshold { --tile: 60px; height: 4px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #ecedea 0, #ecedea var(--tile), transparent var(--tile), transparent calc(var(--tile) * 2), #ecedea calc(var(--tile) * 2)); }

components.name: Hole Tile
components.description: True-black tile holding dated proof or a closing call, with on-hole ink.

March 2015. Four students win Rescue Maze at the Mexican Robotics Tournament.

components.css: .ds-hole { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; padding: 24px; background: #000; color: #a6abb1; font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; line-height: 1.55; max-width: 420px; } .ds-hole strong { color: #ecedea; font-weight: 700; } .ds-hole a { align-self: flex-start; color: #ecedea; font-weight: 650; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 1.5px; text-underline-offset: 0.22em; } .ds-hole a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #8aa6f5; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Sponsor Marquee
components.description: User-pinned continuous linear loop of sponsor logos as light silhouettes; pauses on hover and focus, static under reduced motion.
components.css: .ds-marquee { overflow: hidden; background: #111214; border-top: 1px solid #2a2d31; border-bottom: 1px solid #2a2d31; font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-marquee ul { display: flex; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; width: max-content; animation: ds-run 32s linear infinite; } .ds-marquee:hover ul, .ds-marquee:focus-within ul { animation-play-state: paused; } .ds-marquee li { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 180px; height: 72px; border-right: 1px solid #2a2d31; color: #ecedea; opacity: 0.72; font-weight: 700; font-stretch: 112%; } @keyframes ds-run { to { transform: translateX(-50%); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-marquee ul { animation: none; } .ds-marquee { overflow-x: auto; } }

narrative.overview:
The site is a RoboCup Rescue Maze field seen from above, the arena where the team's first robot won in 2015. Everything sits on one square tile module: a 12-column field (6 columns under 820px) whose tile width is the field width divided by the column count. The floor is a dark, cool field (the shipped state is dark mode, by user decision), seams are hairlines between tiles, walls are light ink bars, hole tiles are true black, and the field's two kinds of marked tile carry meaning: silver checkpoint tiles are the only frame for the two primary actions (Apply to Candidates, Become a sponsor), and royal blue marks "you are here".

Density is editorial rather than dashboard: long single-axis pages, each section separated from the next by a wall with one doorway gap. Content is rows on the floor (dated results, roles, timeline entries) divided by seams and walls, not floating cards. Photography is real team and competition imagery, square-cropped to tiles. Type is Archivo throughout, its width axis doing the work a second family would: the expanded heavy cut for display, normal width for reading.

Motion answers input. A small top-down robot marker travels between nav tiles and down the About year rail; pages already visited stay mapped with a small silver dot. The only continuous motion is the user-pinned sponsor marquee on Home. There is no load-time hero run: the hero photo shows immediately.
keyCharacteristics: One square tile module drives every column, gap and section padding.
Square corners everywhere; borders are walls (2px to 4px light ink) or seams (1px).
Silver checkpoint = primary action, blue = current location or selected state, red = error. Nothing else is colored.
Archivo variable (wdth 62..125, wght 100..900), one family, width as the hierarchy axis.
Dark field, light ink, logos rendered as light silhouettes.

rules.name: The One Meaning Rule
rules.body: Silver means "act here", blue means "you are here / selected", red means "something is wrong". Never use one of them for decoration or for a different meaning.

rules.name: The Checkpoint Scarcity Rule
rules.body: A screen carries at most the two primary actions as checkpoint tiles (plus a form's submit). Every other action is a wall-outline button or a text link.

rules.name: The Width Axis Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from Archivo's width and weight axes, never from a second family. Expanded (wdth 112 to 125) is for headings and tile labels only; reading text stays at normal width.

rules.name: The Plain Label Rule
rules.body: Labels are sentence case at normal tracking. No monospace, no uppercase micro-labels, no small text set above a heading.

rules.name: The Flat Field Rule
rules.body: Nothing on the floor casts a shadow. Separate surfaces with a wall, a seam or a tone step.

dos: **Do** size columns, gaps and padding in tiles so the field stays on one module.
**Do** separate sections with a threshold wall with one doorway, and rows with 1px seams.
**Do** frame the two primary actions (Apply to Candidates, Become a sponsor) and form submits as silver checkpoint tiles with black text, and nothing else.
**Do** use royal blue only for "you are here" and selection, signal blue for blue text and focus, red only for errors.
**Do** keep motion responsive to input: press scale 0.97, 150 to 250ms ease-out state changes, hover effects only on fine pointers, and every animation reduced to near zero under reduced motion.
**Do** render partner logos as light silhouettes on the dark field.
**Do** dim filtered items rather than hiding them.
donts: **Don't** add drop shadows, glows or decorative gradient fills to anything on the floor (the checkpoint bevel, its glint and the sheet lift are the only depth effects).
**Don't** introduce a second typeface, monospace labels, uppercase micro-labels or small text above headings.
**Don't** use any accent color outside its one meaning, or add new hues.
**Don't** add load-time choreography or autoplaying motion; the sponsor marquee is the single continuous loop.
